quickPrompts.label: Design a course
quickPrompts.prompt: I want to build a new course from my sources. Ask me a few questions about the audience and what learners should be able to do afterward, then suggest a course structure with lessons and topics.

quickPrompts.label: Practice scenarios
quickPrompts.prompt: Use my sources to create realistic practice scenarios where learners have to make decisions, choose the best option, and learn from the feedback.

quickPrompts.label: Improve my course
quickPrompts.prompt: Review my current course and tell me where it feels too long, too passive, or hard to follow. Suggest concrete changes.

quickPrompts.label: Summarize my sources
quickPrompts.prompt: Summarize the most important topics in my sources and suggest which ones are worth turning into a course and in what order.
